references.text: Jesus speaks about how a good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit, which is similar to the idea of knowing them by their fruits.
Jeremiah warns against false prophets and says that one can know them by their actions, parallel to knowing them by their fruits.
John the Baptist speaks about how trees that do not bear good fruit will be cut down, which is a similar thought about evaluating based on fruits.
James speaks about how a fig tree cannot bear olives, or a vine figs, which reflects the idea of knowing something by its fruit.
John warns against believing every spirit, but to test them to see if they are from God, which is similar to knowing them by their fruits.
